Test: TC-1778 — Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing -  Editing boxes on the Overview module - log as Box Editor
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-88 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: teamboxes

Steps:
1. Log in as a BoxEditor.
   Data: [Atlassian Server]
username: boxeditor
password: sdfoijj
[Atlassian Cloud]
username: testlab.11@softwareplant.com
password: alamakota123
   Expected: User can be logged on successfully.
2. Navigate to Overview module of Root Box.
   Expected: Overview module loads and boxes are displayed.
3. Click the elipsis icon on the right of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1778 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing -  Editing boxes on the Overview module - log as Box Editor
   Expected: The menu opens. All of the options are grayed out.
4. Click on the optionName
   Data: optionName: Configure
   Expected: Nothing happens. The option is disabled.
5. Hover over the "?" on the right of any grayed out option from the menu.
   Expected: "Insufficient permissions" tooltip is displayed.
6. Click on the chevron on tree root next to boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1778 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing -  Editing boxes on the Overview module - log as Box Editor
   Expected: TC-1778 Program Increment is displayed underneath boxName
7. Click the elipsis icon on the right of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1778 Program Increment
   Expected: The menu opens. All of the options are grayed out.
8. Click on the optionName
   Data: optionName: Configure
   Expected: Nothing happens. The option is disabled.
9. Hover over the "?" on the right of any grayed out option from the menu.
   Expected: "Insufficient permissions" tooltip is displayed.
10. Navigate to Overview module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1778 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing -  Editing boxes on the Overview module - log as Box Editor
   Expected: Overview module loads and boxes are displayed.
11. Open the module switcher.
   Expected: Module switcher opens and modules are displayed. The "Configuration" option at the bottom of the list is grayed out, same as Manage modules option
12. Click on the optionName
   Data: optionName: Configuration
   Expected: Nothing happens. The option is disabled.
